authorized_by: Root integration owner approved this exact phase order and default gate before V7 outcomes.
reason: Prioritize the five V6 strict failures and its additional application-only failure, then execute the remaining eleven cases only if the regression phase clears its predeclared gate. The selection is informed by V6 outcomes and is not a representative or unseen holdout.

dispatch_gate.phase_a: A fresh source freeze, executor hash, configuration manifest, required implementation checks and explicit root execution gate must exist before any V7 model request.
dispatch_gate.phase_b: Every one of the six phase-A cases must have independent strict_pass=true and application_complete=true, then the root integration owner gives phase-B dispatch GO.
dispatch_gate.phase_a_failure: Preserve every failed/incomplete case, actual turn, retry and observed usage. Do not dispatch phase B under the default gate. Mark its eleven cases unrun. A failed case is not silently replayed.
dispatch_gate.source_change_after_phase_a: Any application, prompt, executor or configuration change requires a new candidate revision. Results from different identities cannot be combined into final_v7.
dispatch_gate.interruption: Provider, budget or owner stops preserve actual attempts and planned/observed/unrun turns. An undispatched turn is not an actual run.

identity_requirements: Both phases must reference the same frozen application source inventory, executor, protocol, model, reasoning effort and evaluation configuration.
Each input object must equal the corresponding frozen protocol input exactly; no expected answers, evaluator labels or grading rubric enter model input.
Use fresh isolated sessions per case; Q09 keeps its own session across both turns. Record isolated Operations state and per-case source-status restoration.
Request and verify only gpt-6-luna at medium effort. Keep hosted file search disabled and async tools disabled for this fixed evaluation.
Continue the existing central USD 5 per-run and USD 10 development budget without resetting holds or creating a parallel budget. Only luna_engine dispatches model requests.

reporting.phase_a_only: Report six attempted cases and seven planned turns with actual observed counts. Do not call phase A a completed seventeen-case suite. Q01 baseline comparison is absent from phase A.
reporting.complete_candidate: A seventeen-case result requires all seventeen reviewed cases across both phases, eighteen observed planned turns and matching identities. Otherwise list unrun or incomplete cases explicitly.
reporting.metrics: Keep strict task success, application completion and end-to-end completion separate. Count Q09 once as a case and its distinct runs once in telemetry. Do not pool success rates across source revisions.
reporting.comparison_limit: This is a disclosed development regression suite. Only Q01 has an observed original baseline; no general model improvement or unseen-question performance claim is supported.

source_identity_binding: Pending the not-yet-dispatched V7 source freeze. This plan authorizes no model request by itself. Its SHA-256 must be recorded in the V7 execution manifest.
